Tests that CSS queries, Typed OM computedStyleMap, and font checks are side-effect free.
Expression `CSS.supports('display', 'grid')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `CSS.supports('(display: grid)')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `CSS.escape('foo.bar')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `div.computedStyleMap().get('display')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `div.computedStyleMap().getAll('display')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `div.computedStyleMap().has('display')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `caretPos.getClientRect()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `document.fonts.check('12px serif')`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `document.fonts.load('12px serif')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `document.styleSheets.item(0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `document.styleSheets.item(0).cssRules.item(0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `document.styleSheets.item(0).cssRules.item(0).media.item(0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `document.styleSheets.item(0).cssRules.item(0).media.appendMedium('print')`
has side effect: true, expected: true
